name: halftone
title: Halftone
description: Renders an image as print dots on a canvas, sized by brightness, like a newspaper photo; dots can grow in as it enters the screen.

meta.reducedMotion: Dots render at full size immediately.
meta.useWhen: Print, newspaper, zine, poster, protest and retro concepts.
meta.avoidWhen: Product photos people must inspect; portraits where likeness matters; many on one page.
